column1: Purple Tentacle is\254\001Man of the Year
column2: 紫色觸手當選\254\001年度風雲人物
觸手將代表共和黨\254\001參選副總統

column1: Ah-ha!\255\003A secret passage!\255\003This is all too easy!

column2: 拉玟！\255\003你怎麼跑到樓上來的？

column1: Oh, just something I whipped up in my spare time.
column2: 喔，只是我閒暇時隨手做出來的東西。
其實牠們是不錯的寵物^

column1: ^until one of them tried to take over the world.
Had to tie the little buggers up in the basement.
column2: 只好把那些小混蛋綁在地下室。

column1: Good thing you told us that.
Yeah, Bernard wanted us to set them free!
column2: 對啊，伯納還想放牠們自由呢！

column1: Thank God you weren't THAT stupid.
column2: 謝天謝地你們沒那麼蠢。
是啊，謝謝你，天真的人類！

column1: Now I can finish TAKING OVER THE WORLD!\255\003Ha ha ha!
column2: 現在我可以完成征服世界的大業了！\255\003哈哈哈！

column1: Uh^\255\003I'll try to talk him out of it.
column2: 呃^\255\003我會試著勸他打消念頭。

column1: Well, what possible harm could one insane, mutant tentacle do?
column2: 話說，一隻瘋狂的變種觸手能造成什麼傷害呢？

column1: What have you done this time, you meddling milquetoast?
column2: 你這次又幹了什麼好事，你這個多管閒事的軟腳蝦？

column1: Now Purple Tentacle is free to use his evil mutant powers to take over the world^\255\003^and ENSLAVE ALL HUMANITY!
column2: 現在紫色觸手可以自由運用他邪惡的變種能力征服世界^\255\003^並且奴役全人類了！

column1: Our only hope now is to turn off my Sludge-O-Matic\015 machine^
column2: 我們現在唯一的希望，是關掉我的污泥自動機\015^

column1: ^and prevent the toxic mutagen from entering the river!
column2: ^阻止有毒的致變劑流進河裡！

column1: Isn't it a little late for that, Doctor?
column2: 現在做這個是不是有點晚了，博士？

column1: Of course!\255\003That's why I'll have to do it^
This is all your fault, Bernard.
Doc, can't you just send Bernard?
column2: 博士，你不能只派伯納去嗎？

column1: No, you must all go, to increase the odds that one of you will make it there alive!
column2: 不行，你們都得去，這樣才能提高至少有一個人活著抵達的機率！

column1: Have any people ever been hurt in this thing?
column2: 有人在這東西裡受過傷嗎？

column1: This is the first time I've ever tried it on PEOPLE!
column2: 這是我第一次拿人來試！

column1: And they said imitation diamond wasn't good enough!
column2: 他們還說人造鑽石不夠格呢！

column1: What happened to Hoagie and Laverne?!?
I KNEW I should have bought a REAL diamond!
column2: 我就知道我該買真鑽石的！

column1: My dials say that the larger specimen landed two hundred years in the past^
column2: 我的儀表顯示，比較大的那個標本降落在兩百年前^

column1: ^and the other is stuck two hundred years in the future!
Well, hurry up and bring them back!
column2: 那快點把他們弄回來啊！

column1: I will, as soon as I get a new diamond!
column2: 我會的，等我弄到新鑽石就好！

column1: Then all your buddies have to do is plug in their respective Chron-O-Johns and--
column2: 然後你的朋友們只要把各自的時光廁插上電，然後——

column1: Plug them in?!?\255\003Where is Hoagie going to find an electrical outlet TWO HUNDRED YEARS IN THE PAST!?!
column2: 插上電？！\255\003霍基要去哪裡找兩百年前的插座啊？！

column1: Yes^  well^\255\003He'll be needing my patented super-battery then, won't he?
column2: 是啊^這個嘛^\255\003那他就會需要我那專利超級電池了，不是嗎？

column1: Now, where did I put those patented super-battery plans of mine?
column2: 話說，我把那些專利超級電池的設計圖放哪去了？

column1: Plans?  How are we going to get Hoagie PLANS?
column2: 設計圖？我們要怎麼把設計圖弄給霍基？

column1: Don't worry me with details, boy!\255\003Just help me find the plans!
column2: 別拿細節煩我，小子！\255\003快幫我找設計圖！
它們就在這棟房子裡的某個地方！

column1: Now what am I going to do?
I think I made myself perfectly clear^
